note: The myth desk, as a weekly carousel. Three myths busted per deck, one deck every friday. genmyths.py turns this into myths.html; the slides are the archetype D two-up from BRAND_DESIGN_BIBLE 12.2, which is why they reuse statics.css. Weeks 1 to 12 carry the twelve myths that already existed in statics.json, so nothing written before is wasted.

weeks.title: the app on ur phone
weeks.rule: ask any app which ayanamsa it uses. the ones that can answer are doing arithmetic. the ones that cannot are doing copywriting.

myths.myth: it's the same twelve paragraphs, rotated. nobody is calculating anything.
myths.receipts: swiss ephemeris. lahiri ayanamsa. whole sign houses. every position computed to the arcminute from ur exact birth minute, and every claim carries a number u can check. ask any app which ayanamsa it uses. most cannot answer.

myths.q: every astrology app gives the **same answer**
myths.myth: one sky, one chart, so any two apps should agree exactly.
myths.receipts: they disagree constantly, and the reason is boring. ayanamsa choice moves every position by a fraction of a degree. house system choice can move a planet a whole house. if two apps put ur moon in different rashis, one of them is using a different setting, not a different sky.

myths.q: an app can't do what a **real astrologer** does
myths.myth: software can compute, but the reading itself needs a human in a room.
myths.receipts: half true, and we will say which half. the computation is arithmetic and a machine does it faster and without arithmetic slips. the judgement, the weighing of three signals against each other, is a craft. we hand u the maths openly and tell u where the judgement starts.

weeks.title: what we actually need from u
weeks.rule: we would rather give u less and mean it than give u twelve confident houses built on a guess.

myths.myth: the date is enough. the time is a formality nobody really uses.
myths.receipts: ur moon changes sign every 2.25 days. ur lagna changes every 2 hours. without a time we can give u a rashi and nothing else. we would rather say that than hand u twelve confident houses built on a guess.

myths.q: the time on the **certificate** is exact
myths.myth: it's an official document, so the minute printed on it is the minute u were born.
myths.receipts: it is usually the minute someone wrote it down, which is not the same thing. hospital records round to the nearest five or ten minutes constantly. that is fine for most of a reading and fatal for the few things that turn on the lagna degree. treat it as close, not as gospel.

myths.q: just **guess** the time, it's close enough
myths.myth: pick morning or evening, the chart will still basically work.
myths.receipts: a two hour guess moves ur lagna by a whole rashi, and every house with it. ur career house, ur marriage house, all of it shifts. birth time rectification exists as a discipline precisely because this matters. if u genuinely do not know, read the moon chart and leave the houses alone.

weeks.title: science and the sky
weeks.rule: the positions are astronomy. the meanings are a tradition. anyone who blurs those two is selling u something.

myths.myth: it's all made up, and anyone who takes it seriously is refusing to look at evidence.
myths.receipts: the positional astronomy is exact and computable to the arcsecond. the interpretation on top of it is a tradition. we are honest about which half is which, every single time, and almost nobody else in this category will be.

myths.q: the planets **pull on u** at birth
myths.myth: gravity from mars or saturn shapes the newborn, that's the mechanism.
myths.receipts: no, and no serious jyotishi claims it. the midwife in the room out-pulls mars by a wide margin, and that has been pointed out for decades. jyotisha treats a chart as a map of time, not a force acting on tissue. arguing the gravity version means defending a claim the tradition never made.

myths.myth: science settled this, there is nothing left to discuss.
myths.receipts: what studies have tested is a narrow thing: whether sun sign predicts personality traits in large samples. it does not, and we would not expect it to, because a sun sign is one signal out of dozens. that result is real. it is also not a test of the whole system, and pretending otherwise is bad science in the other direction.

weeks.title: navratri, checked
weeks.hook: 3 navratri beliefs, **one of them is 40 years old**
weeks.rule: a custom does not need to be ancient to be real. it just should not be sold as something it is not.

myths.myth: the navratri colour list is ancient
myths.receipts: it spread through western indian newspapers over the last few decades. lovely, widely kept, and about forty years old.

myths.myth: navratri is one festival, observed the same everywhere
myths.receipts: gujarat dances garba, bengal builds durga puja pandals, the south sets out golu, the north stages ramlila. four festivals, one calendar.

myths.myth: navratri is always nine days, no exceptions
myths.receipts: it runs on tithis, which can be skipped or repeated, so some years it lands on eight or ten days.

weeks.cover: ur navratri colour list is **40 years old**

weeks.title: fasting and vrat
weeks.rule: a vrat is a promise u keep. it is not a payment, and nothing in the sky is invoicing u.

myths.myth: there is one correct way to keep a fast
myths.receipts: fasting rules are regional and always have been. grains or none, sendha namak or none, all nine days or two.

myths.myth: fasting on the right day fixes a bad planet
myths.receipts: the classical remedies are mantra, daan and conduct. no text says a graha is settled by an empty stomach.

myths.q: u **have to** fast on ur graha's day
myths.myth: skip ur shani saturday fast and the dosha gets worse
myths.receipts: weekday lordship is real and the practice is old. the compulsion is fear, and fear is what makes people spend.

weeks.cover: no text says **an empty stomach** settles a graha

weeks.title: mercury retrograde, at the source
weeks.rule: vakri means strong in the classical scoring. the panic is an import, and it is about a hundred years old.

myths.myth: old texts warned against signing or travel during mercury retrograde
myths.receipts: classical vedic astrology scores a retrograde graha as strong: vakri earns cheshta bala. the three week panic is a twentieth century import.

myths.myth: mercury actually reverses direction in space three times a year
myths.receipts: it never does. it only appears to slide back against the stars, an effect of watching from a moving earth.

myths.myth: mercury retrograde only affects gemini and virgo
myths.receipts: a transit is read by where it lands in ur chart. in ur 10th it reads like work, in ur 4th, home.

weeks.cover: classical astrology scores retrograde mercury as **strong**

weeks.title: the three week panic
weeks.rule: read it twice. don't stop.

myths.myth: don't sign anything until mercury goes direct
myths.receipts: three weeks, three times a year, is 18% of ur life. add the shadows: 45%. read it twice. don't stop.

myths.myth: don't travel during retrograde, flights get cancelled
myths.receipts: airlines publish cancellation numbers monthly: weather, staffing, maintenance. none cycle with budha. u just notice the delay and file it as evidence.

myths.q: back up ur phone, **mercury eats data**
myths.myth: back up ur phone, mercury retrograde eats data
myths.receipts: back up ur phone. it's good advice all 365 days, and good advice doesn't need a graha.

weeks.cover: mercury retrograde plus shadows is **45% of ur life**

weeks.title: dhanteras and the muhurat
weeks.hook: 3 myths about **buying at the right time**
weeks.rule: a muhurat is elective. a transit is not. u cannot move a festival to dodge a planet.

myths.myth: skip dhanteras shopping this year, mercury is retrograde
myths.receipts: dhanteras is a tithi, so it can't move. a muhurat is elective, a transit isn't. buy the thing. keep the receipt.

myths.myth: u must buy gold on dhanteras or lose lakshmi
myths.receipts: the older custom is any new utensil or metal object, and steel counts. gold is the version jewellers advertise.

myths.myth: a good muhurat guarantees the business, marriage or move works
myths.receipts: electional astrology picks a favourable start. that's the whole claim. no classical text promises a result. a good start isn't a warranty.

weeks.cover: a **steel vessel** keeps dhanteras just as well

weeks.title: the day it “ends”
weeks.hook: 3 myths about the **end** of a retrograde
weeks.rule: nothing resets on the station day. that expectation is most of why the week after feels stuck.

myths.myth: mercury stations direct and everything goes back to normal
myths.receipts: the post-shadow runs to about 30 november, with mercury crossing the same fifteen degrees a third time. nothing resets on the 13th.

myths.myth: shadow periods are invented to stretch three weeks into ten
myths.receipts: the degrees are real and plottable: mercury crosses the same arc three times. treating all ten weeks as cursed is invented.

myths.q: u can **feel** the exact station day
myths.myth: u can physically feel the day mercury turns direct
myths.receipts: mercury sits nearly still for days around the station. there's no edge to feel. people knew the date, watched, and found it.

weeks.cover: mercury stations direct and **nothing resets**

weeks.title: saturn, the misread one
weeks.rule: for a third of all charts the scariest graha in the system is the one on ur side.

myths.myth: saturn is a bad planet that punishes people
myths.receipts: saturn is the yogakaraka, the single best graha, for vrishabha and tula ascendants, and lagna lord for two more.

myths.q: sade sati is **7 years of ruin**
myths.myth: sade sati is seven and a half years of ruin
myths.receipts: it comes roughly three times in a normal lifespan. if it were ruin, most people would spend a quarter of life ruined.

myths.myth: shani keeps a karma ledger and a hard transit is the bill
myths.receipts: classical texts describe shani as slow, cold, patient and focused on what's load-bearing. the punishment framing came later, and sells remedies.

weeks.cover: saturn is the **single best graha** for two ascendants

weeks.title: manglik dosha
weeks.rule: six houses out of twelve, and dozens of classical cancellations that cost nothing to check.

myths.myth: a manglik marrying a non-manglik is doomed
myths.receipts: it's mars in six of twelve houses. a third to half of everyone qualifies, and the classical cancellations run to dozens.

myths.q: a manglik must **marry a tree** first
myths.myth: a manglik must marry a tree before a real wedding
myths.receipts: it's a regional folk remedy. no classical text prescribes it for mars in the 7th. it's not an entry fee.

myths.myth: manglik secretly means ur partner will die
myths.receipts: no classical basis at that strength. mars there reads as heat, friction and impatience in a partnership. real, workable, worth knowing.

weeks.cover: up to **half of everyone** is manglik

weeks.title: exalted and debilitated
weeks.rule: check the cancellations before anyone says anything final.

myths.myth: a debilitated planet means that part of life is broken
myths.receipts: about 45% of charts have at least one. neecha bhanga cancels a large share, and some texts read that as strength.

myths.q: an **exalted** planet means an easy life
myths.myth: an exalted planet means that part of life just works
myths.receipts: exaltation is one strength measure of several. a planet can be exalted and combust, or exalted and owning two difficult houses.

myths.myth: neecha bhanga is a loophole to soften bad news
myths.receipts: it's a set of stated conditions in the classical texts, and they're checkable, which is exactly what a loophole isn't.

weeks.cover: about **45% of charts** have a debilitated planet

weeks.title: rahu and ketu
weeks.rule: they are two ends of one line. u cannot have one without the other, and they always sit exactly opposite.

myths.myth: rahu and ketu aren't real, so it's all invented
myths.receipts: they're the two points where the moon's path crosses the sun's, exactly where eclipses happen. no rock, real geometry.

myths.myth: rahu only brings obsession, addiction and scandal
myths.receipts: rahu is also foreign things, sudden rise, technology and mass attention. it's the most volatile graha. volatile isn't a synonym for bad.

myths.myth: ketu is just rahu's leftovers, thrown in for symmetry
myths.receipts: they're always 180 degrees apart, so every rahu reading is a ketu reading. where rahu grabs, ketu drops.

weeks.cover: rahu and ketu are where **eclipses happen**

weeks.title: kaal sarp dosha
weeks.rule: check whether it is even in the text before u pay to have it removed.

myths.q: kaal sarp is in the **classical texts**
myths.myth: kaal sarp is an ancient dosha, carried down through parashara
myths.receipts: it's not in brihat parashara hora shastra. it's a twentieth century addition, and its rise tracks the rise of paid puja packages.

myths.q: kaal sarp means ur life is **blocked**
myths.myth: kaal sarp blocks ur life until a special puja removes it
myths.receipts: all seven grahas landing on one side of the nodes happens fairly often. a common configuration can't explain an uncommon outcome.

myths.q: one **puja** at the right temple clears it
myths.myth: one puja at the right temple, for the right price, lifts it
myths.receipts: if the dosha is a modern invention, so is the removal service. the price list came first, the doctrine after.

weeks.cover: kaal sarp is **not in parashara**

weeks.title: gemstones
weeks.rule: never wear a stone for a graha u have not actually checked. a strong stone for a wrong planet is worse than nothing.

myths.q: wear a stone for ur **weakest** planet
myths.myth: wear a stone to prop up ur weakest planet
myths.receipts: most schools strengthen a graha that's functionally benefic for ur lagna. strengthen a weak malefic and u just make things louder.

myths.q: **neelam** works within days or not at all
myths.myth: blue sapphire pays off within days or must come off
myths.receipts: the three day trial is a retail script. neelam is saturn's stone, the slowest graha. why expect it to rush?

myths.myth: a bigger, heavier stone gives u more of the planet
myths.receipts: the texts set modest weights. if the recommendation gets heavier every time ur budget comes up, it's not coming from the chart.

weeks.cover: the 3 day neelam trial is **a retail script**

weeks.title: the year ahead
weeks.rule: one sun sign, twelve paragraphs, a billion people. do that arithmetic once and u never read one the same way again.

myths.q: ur **2027 horoscope** is written for u
myths.myth: the yearly forecast for ur sign predicts ur year
myths.receipts: it's written for one twelfth of the planet, roughly 650 million people. the bits that feel accurate were written to fit anyone.

myths.q: the astrological year starts on **1 january**
myths.myth: the astrological year resets on 1 january
myths.receipts: nothing in jyotisha turns over on 1 january. the tajika annual chart starts at ur solar return, near ur birthday.

myths.myth: jupiter enters ur sign, so ur whole sign gets one year
myths.receipts: a transit is read from ur moon, lagna and dasha. same jupiter, twelve different houses. the sky is shared. ur chart isn't.

weeks.cover: ur yearly horoscope is shared with **650 million people**

weeks.title: which sign is actually urs
weeks.rule: in jyotisha the moon does the work the sun does in the magazines.

myths.myth: the sign u say at parties is the one ur chart uses
myths.receipts: vedic readings are built on the moon rashi and the lagna. a sun sign is the least specific fact in ur chart.

myths.myth: someone moved the signs, and now the wrong one applies
myths.receipts: nobody moved anything. western measures from the equinox, vedic from the fixed stars, and the two have drifted about 24 degrees apart.

myths.q: i'm on the **cusp** of two signs
myths.myth: born near the boundary, so both signs apply a bit
myths.receipts: a rashi is 30 degrees with a hard edge. u're in one. cusp just means u don't know the exact degree.

weeks.cover: about 4 in 5 get a **different vedic sign**

weeks.title: the calendar problem
weeks.rule: two panchangs can disagree and both be computing correctly. check the ayanamsa and the reckoning before u call one wrong.

myths.myth: makar sankranti marks the winter solstice, the shortest day
myths.receipts: the solstice is around 21 december. sankranti is the sun entering sidereal makara. they once coincided, then drifted about 24 days.

myths.myth: one sky, so two panchangs that disagree means one is wrong
myths.receipts: amanta months end at new moon, purnimanta at full moon, so the same month name can land about fifteen days apart.

myths.myth: a tithi is just a date with a sanskrit name
myths.receipts: a tithi is 12 degrees between sun and moon. it can run 20 hours or 27, so some get skipped or repeated.

weeks.cover: makar sankranti drifted **24 days** off the solstice

weeks.title: nakshatras
weeks.rule: 27 nakshatras, 4 padas each, 108 slots. that is the resolution the tradition actually works at.

myths.myth: nakshatras are a nice detail, the rashi is the real info
myths.receipts: the dasha system runs off ur moon's nakshatra. every period and sub-period for 120 years is calculated from it. it's the clock.

myths.q: everyone's nakshatra name is **fixed at birth**
myths.myth: the name syllable from ur nakshatra is a rule u must follow
myths.receipts: naming from the pada syllable is a custom. no text says a child named otherwise is damaged. the guilt is sold separately.

myths.q: **gand mool** nakshatra is bad luck for the family
myths.myth: a child born in a gand mool nakshatra brings trouble to parents
myths.receipts: it's six nakshatras out of 27, about one child in five. the shanti ritual is harmless. calling the baby a hazard isn't.

weeks.cover: about 1 in 5 babies is born **gand mool**

weeks.title: dashas and timing
weeks.rule: a transit says what is in the air. the dasha says whether it is ur turn.

myths.myth: a saturn mahadasha is nineteen years to endure
myths.receipts: what a period does depends on what that graha rules in ur chart. for tula lagna, saturn's nineteen years are the best.

myths.myth: check today's sky, that's the forecast. dashas are secondary.
myths.receipts: classically the dasha sets what's live in ur life, and the transit decides when inside that window it fires.

myths.q: a good astrologer names the **exact day**
myths.myth: a real astrologer names the exact day. vagueness means they don't know.
myths.receipts: a sub-period resolves to weeks, sometimes months. naming the exact day is performance, and it's right just often enough.

weeks.cover: tula lagna's best years are **the saturn dasha**

weeks.title: the 36 gunas
weeks.rule: 36 points is one filter out of several, and two of the eight kootas carry 15 of them.

myths.myth: 18 of 36 is the pass mark. anything under is a no
myths.receipts: the 18 line is a convention. nadi carries 8 and bhakoot 7, both all or nothing, so two technicalities can cost 15.

myths.myth: same nadi means zero points, no exceptions, walk away
myths.receipts: two random people share a nadi about a third of the time. the classical cancellations are written down and free to check.

myths.myth: run the ashtakoota, read the number, done
myths.receipts: the score is built mainly from the two moons. it says nothing about either 7th house, the dashas u're running, or mars.

weeks.cover: two kootas hold **15 of the 36** points

weeks.title: love, and when
weeks.rule: a chart shows the seasons. it does not show the person, and anyone who says otherwise is guessing at ur expense.

myths.q: the chart says u marry at **28**
myths.myth: there's an exact marriage age in ur chart, waiting to be read
myths.receipts: the chart shows windows, usually a year or two wide, set by dashas and transits. an exact age is a confident guess.

myths.myth: one marker in the chart decides love or arranged
myths.receipts: venus and rahu contacts or a 5th and 7th lord link lean one way. they don't decide. the other half is society.

myths.q: an astrologer can name **who** it will be
myths.myth: ur spouse's first letter, direction and profession are all in there
myths.receipts: direction and profession have some classical support and hit at about chance. a name has none. a letter isn't a reading.

weeks.cover: ur chart can't name **who** u'll marry

weeks.title: the 7th house
weeks.rule: the 7th is not just marriage. it is every one to one deal u will ever sign.

myths.myth: the 7th house is the spouse and nothing else
myths.receipts: the 7th is partnership as a category: business partner, opposing counsel, and classically, open enemies. it's whoever sits directly opposite u.

myths.q: a **malefic** in the 7th ruins the marriage
myths.myth: saturn, mars or rahu in the 7th means marriage trouble
myths.receipts: saturn in the 7th classically slows and steadies, and delay isn't damage. one placement is never a verdict.

myths.q: **venus** is the marriage planet for everyone
myths.myth: check venus, that's the love reading for everyone
myths.receipts: for a woman's marriage the karaka is jupiter. the karaka is one of three reads, with the 7th house and its lord.

weeks.cover: ur 7th house is also **ur open enemies**

weeks.title: money in the chart
weeks.rule: a yoga is a capacity. the dasha decides whether u ever get to use it.

myths.myth: a raj yoga in ur chart means money is coming
myths.receipts: raj yogas are common. most charts have one. plenty of people never run the dasha that lets them spend it.

myths.q: the **2nd house** is ur bank balance
myths.myth: the 2nd house is ur bank balance, read it and u know
myths.receipts: the 2nd is what u hold. the 11th is income, the 12th is what leaves. money runs across at least five houses.

myths.myth: a daridra yoga means poverty, it's right there in the name
myths.receipts: names are dramatic because they were memorised in verse. daridra yogas have cancellation conditions. a name alone is a dictionary entry.

weeks.cover: most charts have **a raj yoga** somewhere

weeks.title: career and the 10th
weeks.hook: 3 myths about **what u should do for work**
weeks.rule: a chart narrows the field. it does not hand u a job title.

myths.myth: a good reading names ur exact profession
myths.receipts: the 10th gives a shape: structure or autonomy, people or systems, risk or continuity. the job title takes judgement.

myths.q: a strong **sun** means a government job
myths.myth: a strong sun points u at a government job
myths.receipts: surya is authority and being answerable. under kings that meant royal service. now it's anyone whose name is on the decision.

myths.q: never switch jobs in a **bad transit**
myths.myth: never apply for jobs until saturn moves and mercury goes direct
myths.receipts: follow every rule and about four clean months a year are left. know which quarter is noisy, negotiate somewhere else, and go.

weeks.cover: ur chart's career list predates **product management**

weeks.title: remedies
weeks.rule: the classical remedies are mantra, daan and conduct, and two of those three are free.

myths.myth: a bigger puja or heavier stone gets a stronger result
myths.receipts: the texts keep returning to japa, daan and achara: repetition, giving and conduct. two are free. the price came from the market.

myths.q: the mantra needs an **exact count** or it fails
myths.myth: miss the mantra count and the whole thing is void
myths.receipts: counts are traditional. the idea that a miss voids it is a control mechanism. teachers who teach this say consistency beats arithmetic.

myths.q: a remedy can replace **doing the thing**
myths.myth: fix the graha and the exam or job sorts itself out
myths.receipts: most texts plainly say the opposite. jyotisha describes conditions. it does not do ur work.

weeks.cover: two of the three classical remedies **cost nothing**

weeks.title: the folk file
weeks.rule: half of what gets called astrology in an indian family is folk custom wearing a chart for cover.

myths.myth: an astrologer can read the evil eye in ur chart
myths.receipts: nazar is ancient, widespread folk belief and real culture. no graha rules it, no house holds it. different subject, different ancestry.

myths.myth: certain combinations show someone did black magic on u
myths.receipts: the classical support is thin, the remedy always expensive and urgent. whoever raises this unprompted isn't reading ur chart.

myths.q: an astrologer can read ur **photo or ur palm** instead
myths.myth: ur face or palm says the same as ur birth chart
myths.receipts: samudrika shastra and hasta rekha are separate traditions, own texts and all. selling them as a chart reading is a category error.

weeks.cover: no classical chapter computes **nazar**

weeks.title: the annual chart
weeks.rule: ur astrological year starts on ur solar return, which is near ur birthday and nobody else's.

myths.q: the new year chart starts on ur **birthday**
myths.myth: the annual chart resets on the birthday on ur passport
myths.receipts: it starts at ur solar return: the sun back on its exact birth degree and minute, within a day or so.

myths.q: the annual chart **replaces** the birth chart
myths.myth: new year, new chart, so read that one instead
myths.receipts: tajika reads the year against the natal chart. a promise missing from the birth chart can't show up in a year chart.

myths.q: **muntha** in a bad house ruins the year
myths.myth: muntha in a bad house writes off the whole year
myths.receipts: muntha moves one house per year, so everyone hits the 6th, 8th and 12th on a fixed rotation. everyone.

weeks.cover: ur astrological new year **isn't ur birthday**

weeks.title: the difficult houses
weeks.rule: the dusthanas are where the work is. that is not the same as where the damage is.

myths.q: the **8th house** is the death house
myths.myth: anything in the 8th house is a death warning
myths.receipts: the 8th is longevity, inheritance, other people's money and research. the good texts explicitly warn against predicting death from it.

myths.q: the **6th house** is only illness and enemies
myths.myth: the 6th house is illness and enemies, nothing useful
myths.receipts: it's also discipline, competition and the capacity to fight. athletes, litigators, doctors and soldiers live there.

myths.myth: the 12th house is expenses, endings, everything draining away
myths.receipts: it's also foreign lands, sleep and moksha. everyone who moved abroad has a 12th house story. its theme is what u release.

weeks.cover: the 8th house is behind **every phd**

weeks.title: good planets, bad planets
weeks.rule: there are no good and bad grahas. there are grahas that are good for ur lagna, and that list changes for every one of the twelve.

myths.myth: jupiter is good, mars is bad, same for everyone
myths.receipts: house ownership from ur lagna decides it. jupiter owns two difficult houses for vrishabha. mars is a yogakaraka for karka and simha.

myths.myth: a jupiter aspect on a house solves the problem
myths.receipts: jupiter expands what it touches, good or bad. on a malefic in a difficult house, it can make the difficulty bigger.

myths.myth: the moon is gentle, so a strong moon is always good
myths.receipts: most schools count a waning moon near the sun as malefic. a bright full moon is the strongest benefic.

weeks.cover: mars is a **yogakaraka** for karka lagna

weeks.title: eclipses and sutak
weeks.rule: an eclipse is the nodes doing exactly what the nodes are defined as. it is the most predictable event in the sky.

myths.myth: a grahan is an omen and something bad follows
myths.receipts: eclipses come roughly two to five times a year, predicted centuries ahead. jyotisha reads them as strong periods for the houses touched.

myths.q: **sutak** rules are the same for both eclipses
myths.myth: sutak is one rule and one duration for any eclipse
myths.receipts: about 12 hours before a solar eclipse, about 9 before a lunar, and only where the eclipse is actually visible.

myths.myth: stay indoors, skip knives and food, or the baby is affected
myths.receipts: no mechanism, no evidence, and it's been studied. keep the custom if it comforts u. don't let it override a doctor.

weeks.cover: sutak only applies where the eclipse is **actually visible**

weeks.title: the neighbouring subjects
weeks.rule: if it does not start from a birth time and a computed position, it is not jyotisha. it might still be worth something. it is just not this.

myths.myth: ur life path number is another view of ur chart
myths.receipts: jyotisha computes positions from a birth moment. adding up a date's digits is a different operation from a different tradition.

myths.q: **vastu** and jyotisha are the same subject
myths.myth: vastu and jyotisha are one subject, one practitioner, one bill
myths.receipts: vastu is architecture: orientation, light, air, layout. going from ur chart to ur kitchen direction widens the invoice, and only the invoice.

myths.q: **tarot** readings and chart readings are interchangeable
myths.myth: tarot and a chart reading give the same information
myths.receipts: a chart is fixed at birth and computes the same for anyone. a card draw changes every time. neither verifies the other.

weeks.cover: most numerology in india is **twentieth century**, mostly western

weeks.title: what we won't answer
weeks.rule: the questions we decline are the ones where a wrong confident answer does permanent damage.

myths.q: an astrologer can tell u **when u'll die**
myths.myth: a good astrologer can read ur lifespan from ayurdaya
myths.receipts: the classical longevity calculations contradict each other. being wrong is unforgivable and being right helps nobody, so we don't answer.

myths.q: the chart says whether u'll have **children**
myths.myth: the 5th house gives a yes or no, and a number
myths.receipts: the 5th describes a theme. fertility is medicine. this claim sends people to remedies over doctors. those years don't come back.

myths.myth: the 6th house names the condition, the graha names the organ
myths.receipts: medical astrology maps grahas to body systems. it predates germ theory and isn't a diagnosis. anything medical sounding goes to a clinic.

weeks.cover: we **refuse** to tell u when u'll die

weeks.title: the desk itself
weeks.rule: we will show u the maths, name the tradition, and tell u where the judgement starts. that is the whole promise.

myths.q: u have to **believe** in it to use it
myths.myth: astrology only works for people already convinced
myths.receipts: the positions are computed and the rules are written down, so u can check both. reading a language needs no oath.

myths.myth: the whole point of astrology is finding out what happens
myths.receipts: the useful half is description: what season u are in, where the friction sits. u can check that against ur own life.

myths.q: if it's **free**, it must be worse
myths.myth: the paid reading is the real one, the app is a teaser
myths.receipts: computation is expensive to build and cheap to run, so it's free. we never charge u to remove a fear we invented.

weeks.cover: u don't need to **believe** to read a chart
